name: Valravn
source:
Roses for lovers...Lilies for...the dead?

What was Suraj trying to tell Hakon when he gifted him such a bouquet? Now that Suraj is lost to the Neverplace...Hakon is devastated by grief. He doesn't know where to go or who to turn to. Will the Church Grim turned Priest, Gregory, be able to help? Or will Hakon turn to his father for advice on his next steps? It is the only choice that Hakon has to make.

This small winter-themed game explores the different facets of bereavement and different ways of coping with loss.

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/valravn]itch.io[/url]]
